title: OperatorConfig.signing_key_path format differs between transit and reader
description: transit/src/config.rs OperatorConfig doc says signing_key_path must be 'PKCS#8 DER (PRIVATE KEY PEM label, 48 bytes) or a raw 32-byte seed in PEM form'. reader/src/config.rs OperatorConfig doc says it must be 'exactly 32 bytes (the Ed25519 seed / private scalar)'. These describe different file formats for the same conceptual key. An operator who generates a key with 'stoa-transit keygen' may assume it works for the reader too; the cross-binary behavior is undocumented. Maintenance consequence: future contributors will not know which format to use for which binary without reading both config modules side by side.
